quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 deck: ASICLand says its overseas business reached quarterly revenue of KRW 106 hundred million in Q1 2026, one year after entering overseas markets, and that H1 2026 revenue was KRW 1,137 hundred million with an operating profit of KRW 50 hundred million (a turnaround); it names SK Hynix (N3-N6 next-generation memory controller development) and FADU (high-performance eSSD controller development and mass production) as key high-growth memory customers, and had 264 employees at end-June 2026.
